verdict.rationale: Tavily ships official Python and JavaScript SDKs with rich, documented functionality (search, extract, crawl, map, research, QnA, RAG context) via pip/npm install and quick-start guides, plus reference docs covering auth, rate limits, project/session attribution, and proxy config. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and GitHub repo, and no official OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s).
